description: Is the token in this tweet a rug? Send tweet text or tweet objects: finds contract addresses, token links (DexScreener, pump.fun, explorers) and cashtags, resolves them to tokens on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana, and returns up to 5 risk checks: 0-100 score, avoid/caution verdict, top reasons, simulated sell, liquidity and the deployer's past launches. One price per call. No X access. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

chain.description: Chain for bare 0x addresses; omit it and each is checked where DexScreener lists its deepest pool

text.description: Tweet text (one or several); contract addresses, token links and $cashtags are read from it

tweets.description: Alternatively, tweets as strings or as X API / twit.sh tweet objects (text, full_text, note_tweet, entities.urls are read)

name: tweet_token_shill_check

notes.description: string, e.g. "Rules-based checks, not advice. A cashtag match is a guess

trackRecord.description: string, e.g. "How our scores have fared: https://onchaincheck.dev/track-r
